theater: 山東長白山與淮南都梁宮

battle.name: 孟讓起義
battle.theater: 山東長白山與淮南都梁宮
battle.brief: 大業九年（613）冬十月，齊郡孟讓與王薄等眾十餘萬據長白山，攻剽諸郡；隋遣齊郡通守張須陀進剿，義軍屢挫，南下轉戰江淮。大業十年十二月，孟讓眾據都梁宮，江都郡丞王世充築五柵拒之，一戰盡破、盡虜眾。卡面羅馬標槍為破盾用的一次性投槍，本役無從對應，僅能以義軍投矛與隋軍步槊、馬槊對照。

kit.name: 羅馬標槍
kit.history: 半米長的投槍，槍幹中空。捅穿盾之後就折斷，敵人只能帶著半截槍退回掩體。

countries: 此役的交戰雙方，是隋朝在山東、河北與江淮一線的州郡官軍體系，和聚在長白山的起義聯軍。隋方在大業九年（613）已把府庫、漕運與役夫徵發用到極限：三征高句麗的兵役與轉輸、兩度巡遊江都的儀仗供應、沿運河州縣的括戶，鄉里早已疲敝。留下來的守備只有各郡的郡兵、縣鄉兵與鎮兵，州郡長官多以文官兼領兵事；正軍與重裝騎兵則集在涿郡、黎陽與江都，由虎賁郎將、虎賁將軍與行軍總管分區調度，郡兵之間靠文書往返互相策應，一旦某郡淪陷，往往數月之後才有援軍抵達。起義方沒有任何官府編制。孟讓是齊郡人，出身民間武裝首領，大業九年十月與王薄等眾十餘萬據長白山，攻剽諸郡，靠鄉里流民、山林部眾與掠得的物資維持，組織只到首領號令與分賞戰利品一級，沒有固定給養線，騎兵幾乎沒有，弓弩與長矛都是民間自備。兩造真正的差距不在單件兵器，而在訓練、編制與後勤：隋軍有披甲騎兵、槊弩與攻城器械，義軍靠的則是人數、地形與一擊即走的流動。
countriesEn: The two parties in this campaign were the command system of the Sui prefectures and counties along the Shandong, Hebei and Huai lines, and the rebel coalition that gathered at Changbai Mountain. On the Sui side, by the ninth year of the Daye era (613) the treasury, the canal transport and the labour levy had all been pushed to the limit: three campaigns against Goguryeo had consumed the military service and the transport, the emperor's two tours of Jiangdu had drained the ceremonial retinue and the supplies, and the prefectures along the canal had been squeezed for men; what remained for defence was the militia of the prefectures, the county and village levies and the garrison troops, with most prefectural officers being civil officials who also took charge of military matters. The regular army and the armoured cavalry were concentrated at Zhuojun, Liyang and Jiangdu, and were moved about by the tiger-guard officers, tiger-general officers and campaign commissioners in separate circuits; the prefectural levies were meant to support one another through paperwork travelling back and forth, so that once a commandery fell, reinforcements often arrived only several months later. The rebel side had no official establishment whatever. Meng Rang was a native of Qi commandery and a leader of an armed band from the people; in the tenth month of the ninth year of Daye he and Wang Bo mustered more than a hundred thousand men at Changbai Mountain and began raiding the commands of the region, sustaining themselves on village refugees, the bands of the hills and what they could take. Their organisation reached only as far as the word of the leader and the sharing out of the spoils; there was no fixed line of supply, cavalry was almost absent, and bows, crossbows and spears were whatever the men brought themselves. The real gap between the two sides lay not in any single weapon but in training, organisation and logistics: the Sui had armoured cavalry, lances, crossbows and siege engines, while the rebels relied on numbers, on the ground and on mobility, breaking off after each stroke.
people: 核心人物是孟讓，齊郡人，隋末農民起義首領，生卒年不詳，《隋書》與《資治通鑑》都只稱其為賊帥、齊人。他在大業九年十月起事，次年冬已能號召十餘萬眾，這在隋朝郡兵空虛、山東饑荒的背景下極不尋常。他身邊最主要的合作者是王薄，同樣出身齊郡，兩軍在長白山會合後曾合兵擾動齊郡各縣與郡治，是山東義軍在隋末第一批互相呼應的力量。隋方最關鍵的敵手是張須陀，弘農閿鄉人，弱冠從史萬歲討西爨，大業中由齊郡丞遷齊郡通守，領河南道十二郡黜陟討捕大使，是隋廷在山東唯一能獨立追剿義軍的宿將；其帳下有羅士信與歷城人秦叔寶，後來因截關焚柵之功名震北方。另一個決定孟讓命運的人是江都郡丞王世充，他在大業十年十二月以五柵拒孟讓於都梁宮，一戰盡破十餘萬眾；此後王世充一路升遷，終於取代楊侗篡隋自立。竇建德則是孟讓晚年的同道與最後的依靠，兩人合兵後分別在南北兩線活動。隋煬帝是這輪鎮壓的最高決策者，遠在涿郡、江都與洛陽之間調度，卻從未親臨山東。
peopleEn: The central figure was Meng Rang, a native of Qi commandery and a leader of a peasant rising in the late Sui, of whom neither the Book of Sui nor the Comprehensive Mirror records the dates of birth and death, both content to call him a band commander of Qi. He rose in the tenth month of the ninth year of Daye, and by the winter of the following year he could already call out more than a hundred thousand men, which was quite remarkable in a situation where the Sui prefectural levies were hollow and Shandong was in famine. His principal associate was Wang Bo, also of Qi; after their forces met at Changbai Mountain they moved together against the counties and the commandery seat of Qi, and they were among the first of the Shandong insurgents to rally one another in the late Sui. The decisive opponent on the Sui side was Zhang Xutuo, a native of Keyang in Hongnong, who had served under Shi Wansui against the Xianbei in his youth and in the Daye years rose from magistrate of Qi commandery to its administrator, taking charge of the circuit of twelve commanderies in Henan as inspector for merit and demotion. He was the only seasoned commander the Sui had who could chase the insurgents down in Shandong alone. In his command served Luo Shixin and Qin Shubao of Licheng, who would make their name in the north after the stroke of cutting the pass and burning the stockades. The other man who decided Meng Rang's fate was Wang Shichong, magistrate of Jiangdu, who met him at Duliang Palace with five barricades in the twelfth month of the tenth year of Daye and destroyed a host of more than a hundred thousand in one stroke; Wang Shichong was afterwards promoted step by step until he displaced Yang Tong and founded his own state out of the Sui. Dou Jiande was Meng Rang's later comrade and his last support, and after the two joined their forces they operated on the southern and the northern lines at once. The Yangdi emperor was the supreme decision maker behind the suppression, shifting troops between Zhuojun, Jiangdu and Luoyang, and he never came to Shandong in person.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是羅馬標槍（Pilum），約公元前一百年的羅馬軍團裝備，槍幹中空、槍頭為鐵質，設計的關鍵是讓槍頭捅穿盾牌之後槍桿在盾面彎折，使對手只能帶著半截槍退回掩體；它是一次性消耗品，靠後方作坊不斷補製來維持。本役在長白山、都梁宮一線完全沒有這種兵器，中原亦無投槍制式，只能作為功能對照：義軍手中的投擲長矛與隋軍的步槊、馬槊，都是可反覆捅刺的通用長柄兵器；義軍的弓箭與矢石同樣是消耗品，但材料可就地徵集，補充成本遠低於羅馬標槍。隋軍裝備成套：披兜鍪、穿札甲的騎兵用馬槊衝鋒，步兵以步槊、橫刀、角弓與弩成列，盾位用桃木大盾，弩機以蹶張弩、排弩為主，攻城則備雲梯、撞車、巢車與投石機，糧秣靠運河與淮水轉運。義軍裝備簡陋：削尖木桿長矛、竹木弓、少量自攜的蹶張弩、繩索石索與拒馬木柵，甲胄以葛布與粗麻為主，鎧甲只出現在少數被繳獲的隋軍裝備上。義軍唯一佔優的是人數與箭矢供應，隋軍唯一佔優的是訓練與攻城能力。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Roman pilum, a kit of the Roman legions of about one hundred BC, with a hollow shaft and an iron head; the point of the design was that once the head had punched through a shield the shaft would bend against the shield face, so that the man on the other side could only drag himself back behind cover with half a weapon in his hands. It was a consumable, kept in supply by constant replacement from the workshops behind the line. Nothing of the kind existed on the Changbai Mountain or the Duliang Palace line in this campaign, and the Central Plains had no throwing-pilum standard either, so the card can serve only as a functional comparison. The throwing spears in the rebels' hands and the Sui foot lances and horse lances are all general-purpose pole weapons that can be thrust again and again; the rebels' bows and their showers of arrows and stones are consumables too, but the material could be collected on the spot, and the cost of replacing them was far below that of a Roman pilum. The Sui equipment came as a set: horsemen wearing helmets and lamellar armour charged with the horse lance; infantry stood in ranks with foot lances, sabres, composite bows and crossbows, with large wooden shields covering the men at the shield wall, the crossbows being chiefly the strong-armed single-shot type and the multi-shot rack type; for the attack on walls they had scaling ladders, battering rams, siege towers and stone-throwing engines, and the grain moved along the canals and the Huai. The rebels' equipment was poor: sharpened poles for spears, bows of bamboo and wood, a few strong-armed crossbows carried by the men themselves, rope-sling stones and sharpened wooden barriers; their armour was coarse hemp and kudzu cloth, and proper plate was seen only on the few pieces of Sui kit they had captured. The only advantage the rebels had was in numbers and in the supply of arrows, and the only advantage the Sui had was in training and in siege capability.
tactics: 起義初期的打法是靠地形與人數。孟讓眾據長白山，居高臨下，糧草就地徵取，遇隋軍主力則散入山林，遇郡兵小股則聚而殲之；攻剽諸郡多選在郡府糧秣斷絕、府兵空虛之際，隋廷的郡兵往往只能據城自守。張須陀的制壓方式與義軍正好相反：他不追求追擊，而是以精兵結陣、進逼據點，斷其水源糧道，再以奇兵襲營。破盧明月於祝阿時，他將萬人邀敵、相持十餘日至糧盡，羅士信與秦叔寶各將千人伏於葭葦中，斬關納外兵，縱火焚其三十餘柵，一舉破局。義軍眾雖有十餘萬而編制散，柵一破即崩潰。孟讓南下轉戰江淮後改取流動與依水據險，仍不善攻堅。大業十年十二月都梁宮之役是這一戰法的終點：王世充築五柵閉門拒守，不與義軍野戰，只以弩矢與矢石消耗其銳氣，待其疲敾而後出城反擊，盡虜其眾。補給方面，義軍吃糧於野、就地徵求，隋軍則靠江都、泗州一線的糧船與運河轉運，攻防的節奏完全由糧道長短決定。
tacticsEn: At the beginning the rising fought with the ground and with numbers. Meng Rang's men held Changbai Mountain, high ground, took their grain on the spot, broke up into the hills whenever the Sui main force appeared and closed on isolated detachments of prefectural levies; the raids on the commands of the region were timed for the moments when the commandery granaries were empty and the soldiers had gone, and the Sui levies as a rule could only shut themselves up in the walled towns and wait. Zhang Xutuo's way of suppressing them was the exact opposite: he did not chase them, but closed up with picked troops, pressed the strongpoints, cut their water and their supply, and then fell on the camp with a detachment. When he took on Lu Mingyang at Zhu'a he led ten thousand men to engage, held on for more than ten days until his own food ran out, and then had Luo Shixin and Qin Shubao take a thousand men each and lie hidden in the reeds, cut the pass to let the foreign troops in and set fire to the more than thirty stockades, breaking the enemy in a single stroke. The rebel host was more than a hundred thousand strong but loosely organised, and once the stockades burned it dissolved. After Meng Rang moved south and campaigned in the Huai region he switched to movement and to holding by the water, and he was still no hand at siege. The action at Duliang Palace in the twelfth month of the tenth year of Daye was the end point of that method: Wang Shichong threw up five barricades, shut the gates and refused to give battle in the open, wearing down the sharpness of the rebels with crossbow bolts and stones from the walls, and only struck out of the city once they were spent, capturing their force entire. On supply, the rebels lived off the country and collected grain where they stood, while the Sui drew theirs by grain boat and canal from the Jiangdu and Sizhou line; the rhythm of attack and defence was decided entirely by the length of the supply road.
data: 可考的時間與數字如下。大業九年（613）冬十月，《隋書·煬帝紀》記「齊人孟讓、王薄等眾十餘萬，據長白山，攻剽諸郡」，起義首月即是全線高潮，兵眾在十餘萬的量級，其後經一年擴張而無更細的計數，應視為量級而非確數。大業十年（614）十二月，《隋書》再記「賊帥孟讓眾十餘萬據都梁宮，江都郡丞王世充擊破，盡虜其眾」，是此役規模最大的一次交鋒。張須陀一線的數字見於《隋書·張須陀傳》：他將萬人邀擊盧明月，與敵相持十餘日而糧盡，遣羅士信、秦叔寶分將千兵伏於葭葦之中，斬關納外兵，縱火焚其三十餘柵。距離上，長白山（濟北鄆城、鄆平一帶）至都梁宮（淮水下游，今江蘇淮安一帶）直線約三百餘公里，折合六百餘里；義軍南下走的是泗水、淮水一線的陸路與水路，隋軍則由江都、泗州方向策應。雙方兵力對比在史籍中無確數，只能作量級對照：義軍十餘萬且多無鎧甲，隋軍出動者以郡兵與精兵數千為主。孟讓的卒年與死因，《隋書》與《資治通鑑》均未詳記，大業十三年（617）前後已不見其名於紀事。
dataEn: The datable points and the figures are as follows. In the tenth month of the ninth year of Daye (613) the Book of Sui, in the annals of the Yangdi emperor, records that the men of Qi under Meng Rang and Wang Bo, more than a hundred thousand of them, held Changbai Mountain and raided the commands of the region; the first month of the rising was already the high point of the whole front, and the size of the force stands in the order of a hundred thousand, with no finer count in the following year of expansion, so it should be taken as an order of magnitude and not a firm figure. In the twelfth month of the tenth year of Daye (614) the Book of Sui records once more that the band commander Meng Rang, with more than a hundred thousand men, occupied Duliang Palace, and that Wang Shichong, magistrate of Jiangdu, defeated him and took his entire force captive; that was the largest single engagement of the campaign. The figures on the Zhang Xutuo side come from his biography in the Book of Sui: he led ten thousand men to engage Lu Mingyang, held the enemy for more than ten days until his own food was exhausted, and then sent Luo Shixin and Qin Shubao with a thousand men each to lie hidden in the reeds, cut the pass to admit the foreign soldiers and set fire to more than thirty stockades. As to distance, the straight line from Changbai Mountain, in the Yuncheng and Yunping area of northern Ji, to Duliang Palace, on the lower Huai in what is now Huai'an in Jiangsu, is about three hundred kilometres, or six hundred li. The rebels moved south by the land and water routes of the Si and the Huai, while the Sui came to meet them from the Jiangdu and Sizhou direction. There is no firm count in the histories for the forces on either side, so only an order of magnitude can be given: the rebels numbered more than a hundred thousand, most of them without armour, and the Sui troops actually engaged were the prefectural levies and some thousands of picked men. Neither the year of Meng Rang's death nor its cause is set out in the Book of Sui or the Comprehensive Mirror, and his name is no longer found in the annals around the thirteenth year of Daye (617).
cause: 起義的起因有三層。最外一層是隋朝在東北方向的消耗：大業六年（610）起兵征高句麗，役後大敗，府庫空虛，役夫與逃戶被集中編入軍隊，戶籍與里甲形同崩壞；其後連年再征，兩度巡遊江都又抽走沿運河的物資，山東、河北一線的漕糧與役力同時見底。第二層是災害與饑荒。大業九年前後山東水旱並至，饑民大批淪為流民與盜匪，齊郡一帶尤其為甚，這正是孟讓、王薄這類民間武裝首領能夠聚眾的社會基礎；山東同時流傳反隋歌謠，長白山之名在民間被附會為義軍聚集的符號，一呼而眾至。第三層是隋廷的應變能力不足：涿郡的軍情與齊郡的戰事相隔數千里，中央每次調兵、每次改派都要等文書往返，地方守將常常在戰機已失之後才收到命令；郡兵久欠操練，府兵制在開皇年間尚能作戰，到大業年間已名存實亡。孟讓起義正是這股洪流中最早成規模的一支。
causeEn: The revolt had three layers of cause. The outermost was the drain of the Sui in the northeast: armies were raised against Goguryeo from 610, the war was lost badly and the treasury emptied, and the labour and the runaways were herded into the ranks until the household registers and the village system existed in name only. Further campaigns followed, the emperor's two tours of Jiangdu drew off the goods of the prefectures along the canal, and the grain transport and the labour of the Shandong and Hebei lines bottomed out together. The second was disaster and famine. Around the years 609 to 613 floods and droughts struck Shandong, the hungry fell in large numbers into flight and into banditry, and the region of Qi commandery more than anywhere else; that was the social ground on which leaders of armed bands like Meng Rang and Wang Bo could gather men. Shandong also passed round songs against the Sui, and the name of Changbai Mountain was turned in the mouths of the people into a sign that the insurgents were gathering there, so that a single call brought a host together. The third was the failure of the court to respond in time. The military situation at Zhuojun and the fighting in Qi were a thousand li apart, and every redeployment and every change of orders had to wait for documents to travel; local commanders often received their instructions only after the opportunity had gone. The prefectural levies had long gone without drill, and the fubing system, which could still fight in the Kaihuang years, existed in name only by the years of Daye. The rising of Meng Rang was the first of that flood to reach scale.
impact: 孟讓起義的影響，第一層在山東。長白山聚眾十餘萬、攻剽諸郡，使齊郡及周邊各郡的郡兵秩序崩解，隋廷不得不多線用兵，張須陀等一批宿將疲於奔命，無法同時守住山東與河北；後來張須陀所部在大業十四年（618）正月於漳水下游覆沒並陣亡，隋朝在北方最後一支能打的部隊就此消失，瓦崗軍得以在黎陽、洛陽一線坐大，李密於是有了與王世充、竇建德三分天下的資本。第二層在江淮。孟讓率眾南下轉戰江淮，把戰火帶到運河與淮水沿線，江都、泗州一線的漕運與治安為之中斷，隋朝僅餘的物資調度線拉長數百里，這也是王世充能在江淮一線迅速積累兵力的背景。第三層在編制層面：義軍憑藉的是首領個人號召與財物均分的連結方式，一旦首領受挫或被分化，隊伍便迅速瓦解；盡虜其眾之後，散卒一部歸入竇建德在河北的聯軍，一部流入瓦崗，隋末最大的兩支農民軍都吸收了孟讓部眾的殘餘。
impactEn: The effect of the rising of Meng Rang had three layers. The first lay in Shandong. The mustering of more than a hundred thousand at Changbai Mountain and the raids on the commands broke up the order of the prefectural levies in Qi and its neighbours, and the court was forced to fight on several lines at once; the seasoned commanders such as Zhang Xutuo were worn out by running from one to another and could no longer hold both Shandong and Hebei. When Zhang Xutuo's own force was destroyed and he killed on the lower reaches of the Zhang river in the first month of the fourteenth year of Daye (618), the last fighting force the Sui still had in the north was gone, the Wagang army was able to grow powerful on the Liyang and Luoyang line, and Li Mi gained the capital to contend with Wang Shichong and Dou Jiande for the empire. The second lay in the Huai region. Meng Rang carried the war south into the Huai and turned the fighting into the corridors of the canal and the river, interrupting the grain transport and the public order of the Jiangdu and Sizhou line and stretching the court's remaining lines of supply by several hundred li; that too was the background against which Wang Shichong could build up forces quickly in the Huai. The third lay in the matter of organisation. What held the insurgents together was the personal call of the leader and an even sharing out of the plunder; once the leader was checked or the band divided, the force dissolved quickly. After the captives were taken, part of the men joined Dou Jiande's coalition in Hebei and part flowed to Wagang, so that the two greatest peasant armies of the late Sui both took in the remnants of Meng Rang's host.
result: 以大業九年冬十月起事、大業十年十二月兵敗都梁宮為界線，孟讓起義前後不過一年有餘，卻是隋末山東規模最大的一次集結：十餘萬眾的說法在《隋書》紀事中兩度出現，說明其爆發力遠勝同期的零星響應。結果則是失敗。眾據都梁宮之後被江都郡丞王世充一戰而破，盡虜其眾，義軍的組織核心在這個冬天被打散；孟讓本人收拾殘部轉戰江淮，其後與竇建德合兵，於大業十三年（617）前後在南北兩線同時受挫，並死於兵中，卒年與死因史無明文，一說中流矢，一說病歿。其部眾沒有消失：被解散的十餘萬人中，一部分歸入竇建德在河北的聯軍，一部分流向瓦崗，成為唐初平定河北與洛陽線的基本兵源。從大歷史看，這場起義沒有建立任何政權，卻用一次大規模的兵潰，替瓦崗與竇建德兩軍騰出了北方，也替隋朝的最後崩解寫下了開端。
resultEn: Taking the rising in the tenth month of the ninth year of Daye and the defeat at Duliang Palace in the twelfth month of the tenth year as its boundaries, the revolt of Meng Rang lasted a little over a year, and yet it was the largest muster in Shandong in the late Sui: the figure of more than a hundred thousand men appears twice in the annals of the Book of Sui, which shows that its burst of strength far exceeded the scattered risings of the same months. The result, however, was failure. After the host had occupied Duliang Palace it was broken in a single battle by Wang Shichong, magistrate of Jiangdu, and taken captive entire, and the organisational core of the insurgents was scattered in that winter. Meng Rang himself gathered up the remnants and campaigned in the Huai region, later joining his forces to Dou Jiande's; around the thirteenth year of Daye (617) they were checked on the northern and the southern lines at once, and Meng Rang died in the field, with no clear record in history of the year or the manner of his death, some accounts saying that he was struck by an arrow and others that he died of sickness. His men did not disappear: of the hundred thousand and more who were scattered, part were absorbed into Dou Jiande's coalition in Hebei and part flowed to Wagang, and they became the basic source of troops for the Tang in settling the Hebei and the Luoyang lines. Seen in the long run, this rising founded no state of its own, but by one great break of an army it cleared the north for the two forces of Wagang and Dou Jiande, and it wrote the opening of the last dissolution of the Sui.
